title: Baicalein attenuates oxidative damage in mice haematopoietic cells through regulation of PDGFRbeta.
authors: Ren, Huanying; Feng, Jingyi; Hong, Minglin; Liu, Zhuang; Muyey, Daniel Muteb; Zhang, Yaofang; Xu, Zhifang; Tan, Yanhong; Ren, Fanggang; Chang, Jianmei; Chen, Xiuhua; Wang, Hongwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物BAI通过PDGFRbeta调控小鼠造血细胞氧化损伤，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是细胞/动物表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta (PDGFRbeta) plays a crucial role in murine haematopoiesis. Baicalein (BAI), a naturally occurring flavonoid, can alleviate disease damage through anti-oxidative, anti-apoptotic, and anti-inflammatory mechanisms. However, whether BAI attenuates oxidative damage in murine haematopoietic cells by PDGFRbeta remains unexplored. In this study, we utilized a tert-butyl hydroperoxide (TBHP)-induced BaF3 cell injury model and an ionising radiation (IR)-induced mice injury model to investigate the impact of the presence or absence of PDGFRbeta on the pharmacological effects of BAI. In addition, the BAI-PDGFRbeta interaction was characterized by molecular docking and dynamics simulations. The results show that a specific concentration of BAI led to increased cell viability, reduced reactive oxygen species (ROS) content, upregulated nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) expression, and its downstream target genes heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1) and NAD(P)H Quinone Dehydrogenase 1 (NQO1), and activated protein kinase B (AKT) pathway in cells expressing PDGFRbeta plasmid and experiencing damage. Similarly, BAI elevated lineage(-)Sca1(+)cKIT(+) (LSK) cell proportion, promoted haematopoietic restoration, enhanced NRF2-mediated antioxidant response in PDGFRbeta(+/+) mice. However, despite BAI usage, PDGFRbeta knockout mice (PDGFRbeta(-/-)) showed lower LSK proportion and less antioxidant capacity than the total body irradiation (TBI) group. Furthermore, we demonstrated an interaction between BAI and PDGFRbeta at the molecular level. Collectively, our results indicate that BAI attenuates oxidative stress injury and helps promote haematopoietic cell recovery through regulation of PDGFRbeta.
abstract_zh: 血小板衍生生长因子受体β（PDGFRbeta）在小鼠造血中发挥关键作用。黄芩素（BAI）是一种天然类黄酮，可通过抗氧化、抗凋亡和抗炎机制减轻疾病损伤。然而，BAI是否通过PDGFRbeta减轻小鼠造血细胞的氧化损伤尚待探索。在本研究中，我们利用叔丁基过氧化氢（TBHP）诱导的BaF3细胞损伤模型和电离辐射（IR）诱导的小鼠损伤模型，探讨PDGFRbeta存在与否对BAI药理效应的影响。此外，通过分子对接和动力学模拟表征了BAI-PDGFRbeta相互作用。结果表明，特定浓度的BAI在表达PDGFRbeta质粒并经历损伤的细胞中导致细胞活力增加、活性氧（ROS）含量降低、核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）及其下游靶基因血红素加氧酶1（HO-1）和NAD(P)H醌脱氢酶1（NQO1）表达上调，并激活蛋白激酶B（AKT）通路。类似地，BAI在PDGFRbeta(+/+)小鼠中提高了lineage(-)Sca1(+)cKIT(+)（LSK）细胞比例，促进造血恢复，增强NRF2介导的抗氧化反应。然而，尽管使用BAI，PDGFRbeta敲除小鼠（PDGFRbeta(-/-)）的LSK比例和抗氧化能力仍低于全身照射（TBI）组。此外，我们在分子水平上证明了BAI与PDGFRbeta之间的相互作用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，BAI通过调控PDGFRbeta减轻氧化应激损伤并有助于促进造血细胞恢复。
